Roles for job functions

This page lists the predefined roles that are designed to be granted to users with specific job functions in Google Cloud. For more information about who these roles are intended for, see Predefined roles for job functions.

Role Permissions

Data Scientist

(roles/iam.dataScientist)

Designed for a data scientist power user to manage data platform services and associated Compute services for analyzing data and building data processing, transformation and analysis pipelines.
